dreamteamer.title: Recordings
dreamteamer.description: One audio file and its transcript per `meeting-recordings` record. Audio dropped into an `${env:INBOX_FOLDERS}` root is deduped by content hash, archived under `${env:FILES_FOLDER}`, matched to its meeting (stamping `meetings.recordings`) and transcribed offline with speaker diarisation, in Hebrew and English. Summaries, tasks and critiques built on a transcript are the `meeting-docs` module.
